caption: The drawing depicts a dark bronze or black metallic statue of a nude male figure standing on a round, dark-colored base. The figure is holding a large, shallow, oval-shaped basket that is yellow with a textured surface and contains a couple of indistinct objects, possibly food items. The figure is shown in a three-quarter view, with the body facing slightly to the left and the basket supported by both hands in front of the body. To the lower right of the main drawing, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the same statue in blue, showing the side profile of the figure, also holding the basket and standing on a similar round base. The background is plain and light-colored, with the artist's signature "E. Boettcher" visible in the lower-left corner.
title: Nubian with Cotton Basket Card Tray
